notes.title: Outlaw Squadron Missions Update
notes.content:
[h1]New mission flow[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pilots, airplanes, maneuvers and other rewards can only be acquired by winning battles
[*] After each battle player acquires Victory Streak bonus, which is lost when defeated or returned to base
[*] When defeated, player loses all rewards acquired since last return to base
[/list]
